aluminum_weight_fraction.label: Aluminum fraction of total article weight

steel_weight_fraction.label: Steel fraction of total article weight

copper_weight_fraction.label: Copper fraction of total article weight

usmca_properly_claimed.label: USMCA treatment properly claimed for this entry

aluminum_primary_smelted_or_cast_russia.label: Any primary aluminum smelted in Russia or article cast in Russia

aluminum_origin_canada_mexico.label: Aluminum produced in Canada or Mexico
aluminum_origin_canada_mexico.description: Note 16(h)/(i): steel melted and poured; aluminum smelted and cast.

commerce_authorized_aluminum_quantity.label: Shipment within Commerce-authorized aluminum quantity
commerce_authorized_aluminum_quantity.description: Documented authorization pursuant to Proclamation 10984 clause 13 and note 16(h)/(i), including required CBP information.

uk_aluminum_origin_fraction.label: Qualifying UK fraction of aluminum
uk_aluminum_origin_fraction.description: Note 16(d). For steel, include Tata Steel UK steel reported melted/poured in the Netherlands as permitted by 91 FR 23056-23057 through January 1, 2028. Aluminum must be smelted OR most recently cast in the UK.

us_aluminum_origin_fraction.label: U.S. origin fraction of aluminum
us_aluminum_origin_fraction.description: Note 16(e): aluminum smelted and cast (steel: melted and poured) in the United States, divided by total aluminum weight. Requirements are cumulative for overlapping lists.

us_steel_origin_fraction.label: U.S. origin fraction of steel
us_steel_origin_fraction.description: Note 16(e): steel smelted and cast (steel: melted and poured) in the United States, divided by total steel weight. Requirements are cumulative for overlapping lists.

uk_steel_origin_fraction.label: Qualifying UK fraction of steel
uk_steel_origin_fraction.description: Note 16(d). For steel, include Tata Steel UK steel reported melted/poured in the Netherlands as permitted by 91 FR 23056-23057 through January 1, 2028. Aluminum must be smelted OR most recently cast in the UK.

parts_exclusively_for_us_note16_equipmen.label: Parts used exclusively to manufacture qualifying equipment in the U.S.
parts_exclusively_for_us_note16_equipmen.description: Note 16(k): agricultural/fixed industrial equipment in (c)(ix)-(x), or mobile industrial equipment in (c)(xi). The final equipment classification and exclusive manufacturing use must be established.

motorcycle_part_for_us_manufacture.label: Motorcycle part for U.S. motorcycle manufacturing
motorcycle_part_for_us_manufacture.description: U.S. note 16(g): actual motorcycle part and U.S. manufacturing use, not just a Chapter 84/85/87 classification.

us_produced_parts_value.label: Value attributable to parts produced in the U.S.
us_produced_parts_value.description: Note 16(j): documented U.S.-produced parts value, not the origin of raw steel and not a trade share.
